attributes.board_name: Maine Board of Occupational Therapy Practice (Office of Professional and Occupational Regulation)

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE relevant to OT or interprofessional practice; at least 4 hours from presentations offered by a recognized sponsor (MEOTA, NBCOT, AOTA or AOTA-approved providers). Other activities: workshops, seminars, conferences, in-service; academic coursework (on-site or distance); publications; preparing to teach in an accredited OT program; presenting; reviewing critically appraised topics; research; Level I fieldwork supervision (1 h per student), Level II (2 h per student). In-person or live interaction not required. Hours also used for NBCOT renewal may count.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: 1 hour of ethics plus half of the required hours.
rules.audit_note: Certification at renewal is subject to audit and record retention under OPOR rules 02-041 CMR ch. 13; a failed audit may lead to discipline.

topics.who: Ethics in the practice of OT; counts toward the 10

rules.notes: Licenses expire annually on March 31; reporting period April 1 of the previous year through March 31. 1 hour = 60 minutes. Deferment possible for prolonged illness on written request before expiry.
